nodes.name: Ti substrate pretreatment
nodes.procedure: TA2 grade pure Ti with the thickness of 1 mm was used as the substrate. The Ti plates were ultrasonically cleaned in ethanol and deionized water for 15 min to remove oil stains and impurities on the surface. The Ti plates were etched in sulfuric acid solution (20 wt%) at 95°C for 2 h, during which nitrogen was sparged into the solution at a flow rate of 4 L min⁻¹. The etched Ti plates were washed with deionized water and then dried in air.

nodes.name: Precursor solution preparation
nodes.procedure: Hexachloroimidium acid hydrate (H₂IrCl₆·xH₂O Ir 35% in HCl) and lithium hydrate (LiOH) were added into a mixture of ethanol (C₂H₆O) and isopropanol (C₃H₈O) with the molar ratio of 1:1 and then dissolved ultrasonically for 15 min. The Ir concentration in the precursor solution is 1.5 mg mL⁻¹. The subsequently prepared DSAs are named LIC-x (x, the molar mass ratio of Li to Ir).

nodes.name: LIC-4 DSA coating by thermal decomposition
nodes.procedure: The precursor was painted on the etched Ti substrate surface by 15 layers. After each painting, the sample was dried at 120°C for 10 min and then calcined at 450°C for 10 min. Finally, after painted for 15 layers, the plates were calcined at 450°C for 120 min. Each DSA sample had an iridium loading of about 1.5 mg cm⁻². The subsequently prepared DSAs are named LIC-x (x=4, the molar mass ratio of Li to Ir).

nodes.description: OER performance in 0.5 mol L⁻¹ H₂SO₄
nodes.source_text: The OER electrocatalytic activity of coatings was evaluated by LSV... LIC-4 shows an extremely remarkable OER performance with a low onset potential of 1.46 V versus RHE and achieves 10 and 100 mA cm⁻² as low as 1.50 and 1.56 V, respectively. The OER Tafel slope of LIC-4 is only 41 mVdec⁻¹... LIC-4 exhibits excellent electrochemical stability during the OER process... LSV curves before and after 10,000 cycles... constant under 10 mAcm⁻² for 72h... accelerated life test... 168h under 1000 and 2000 mAcm⁻².

nodes.description: HER performance in 0.5 mol L⁻¹ H₂SO₄
nodes.source_text: The HER catalytic performance of LIC-4... LSV curves... low onset potential of -0.038 V versus RHE and reached -10 and -100 mAcm⁻² at overpotentials of 69 and 122 mV, respectively. The Tafel slope of LIC-4 for HER is only 31 mVdec⁻¹... LSV curves before and after 10,000 cycles... almost constant under 10 mAcm⁻² for 72h.

nodes.description: ECSA determination and comparison by CV
nodes.source_text: The electrochemical active surface area (ECSA) of the DSAs was determined by cyclic voltammetry (CV) with the potential sweep rate ranged from 10 to 50 mVs⁻¹. The ECSA of LIC-4 is 4245 cm², whereas the IrO₂ coating is only 245 cm².

nodes.characterization_summary: LIC-4 exhibits standard rutile IrO2 phase with significantly wider FWHM than IrO2, indicating reduced grain size.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The DSA coatings exhibit a standard phase of rutile iridium dioxide with a wider full width at half-maximum (FWHM). The FWHM of the coating prepared with LiOH addition is significantly wider than that without LiOH addition, indicating that the grain size of the LIC-4 is reduced...

properties.description: X-ray diffraction pattern with main plot (10-90° 2θ) and inset (27-36° 2θ)

nodes.characterization_summary: LIC-4 shows three major Raman peaks at 561, 728, and 752 cm⁻¹ for Eg, B2g, and A1g modes of rutile IrO2 with red-shift and tendency toward B2g mode due to nano-sized grains.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Three major Raman peaks exhibited typical Ir-O vibrations, and, namely, the Eg, B2g, and A1g modes for rutile IrO2 are located at 561, 728, and 752 cm⁻¹. Red-shift phenomenon caused by surface stress during sequential layered thermal decomposition was observed...

properties.description: Stacked Raman spectra at different temperatures

nodes.characterization_summary: LIC-4 shows Ir4+ (61.7/64.7 eV) and Ir3+ (62.3/65.3 eV) with Ir3+:Ir4+ ratio 8.18 vs 0.95 for IrO2; O 1s lattice oxygen (529.9 eV), O-OH (530.9 eV), H2O (532.6 eV) with hydroxyl ratio 0.49 vs 0.34 for IrO2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Both Ir4+ with the binding energies of 61.7 and 64.7 eV and Ir3+ with the binding energies of 62.3 and 65.3 eV... the Ir3+ to Ir4+ ratio in the DSA coatings dramatically increased from 0.95 to 8.18... The peaks with the binding energies of 529.9, 530.9, and 532.6 eV... The hydroxyl group ratios in IrO2 and LIC-4 are 0.34 and 0.49, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: LIC-4 presents hierarchical porous microtopography with multichannel trench and dense deep voids; coating thickness ~20 μm with high porosity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: LIC-4 presents a hierarchical porous microtopography with multichannel trench and dense deep voids with extensive connectivity... Coatings with a thickness of about 20 μm are densely covered on the Ti substrate with high porosity.

properties.description: Porous material with irregular, clustered particles showing rough surface morphology

nodes.characterization_summary: LIC-4 exhibits nanocrystalline structure with grain size <5 nm, plentiful defects and grain boundaries.
nodes.evidence_snippet: LIC-4 exhibits a nanocrystalline structure, and the grain size is smaller than 5 nm. Plentiful of defects and grain boundaries provide active sites for electrocatalysis.

nodes.characterization_summary: LIC-4 confirms rutile structure in darkfield with even Ir and O distribution.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The rutile structure is shown in darkfield, and FFT analysis points to the same result... oxygen and iridium are evenly distributed in LIC-4.
